items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Paul L. Howard by the interviewee or interviewer in relation to Leroy Prinz. The only mention is the interviewer stating 'I was more or less with Leroy Prinz', which describes the interviewer's relationship, not the interviewee's.

ctx.x: We were talking about the studios
Yes, I was more or less with Leroy Prinz when he was at Paramount and I was assistant dance instructor to he and his brother.
What were some of the films?
